title: Compute enrollment codes
responsibility: Commit to a new device's keys and compute the 6-digit code both devices show during enrollment.

inputs.name: sealedEnrollCommit.keys
inputs.description: New device's public key-agreement and signing keys.

inputs.name: sealedEnrollCommit.nonce
inputs.description: New device's nonce kept private until it is revealed to the approver.

inputs.name: checkEnrollCommit.keys
inputs.description: Public keys presented by the enrolling device.

inputs.name: checkEnrollCommit.nonce
inputs.description: Nonce revealed by the enrolling device.

inputs.name: checkEnrollCommit.commitment
inputs.description: Commitment received before the enrolling device revealed its nonce.

inputs.name: sealedSas.input
inputs.type: { request: SealedEnrollKeys; requestNonce: Uint8Array; approverSigningPublic: Uint8Array; approverNonce: Uint8Array; }
inputs.description: Enrolling device's public keys, approver's public signing key, and both devices' nonces.

outputs.name: sealedEnrollCommit
outputs.description: Hex commitment to the enrolling device's keys and nonce.

outputs.name: checkEnrollCommit
outputs.description: Whether the revealed keys and nonce reproduce the received commitment.

outputs.name: sealedSas
outputs.description: Zero-padded six-digit enrollment code shown on both devices.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: A supplied enrollment key or nonce has an invalid length.
